cases.question: Who owns the Gross Margin metric in KPI Tree, and who do they report to?
expected_behavior: The agent resolves the metric by name with search_metrics rather than guessing an identifier
The agent reads the RACI from analyze_metric, including team, department and manager
The answer names people, never UUIDs
cases.ground_truth: A single-fact ownership question: one analyze_metric call answers it from the RACI.

cases.question: Is there a data issue with our KPI Tree metrics this morning? A few numbers look stale.
expected_behavior: The agent starts with analyze_metric on the metrics named, reading pipeline health and blast radius
The agent does not start in the warehouse
The agent distinguishes a stale pipeline from a real change in the number

cases.question: What is revenue month to date in KPI Tree?
expected_behavior: The agent answers a single-fact question with one analyze_metric call
The agent quotes the month-to-date figure with the to-date-versus-previous comparison, never month on month

cases.question: Which KPI Tree tools can I use as a viewer? The assistant keeps telling me a tool is off.
expected_behavior: The agent explains the viewer, editor and admin roles and the features a workspace may not have switched on
The agent says a refused tool is off for this person or workspace and does not tell a viewer to run an editor tool

cases.question: Show me our metric structure in KPI Tree.
expected_behavior: The agent lists the trees with list_trees and opens the relevant one with get_tree
The agent describes the structure by metric name

cases.question: Who owned Gross Margin back in March, before the reorg?
expected_behavior: The agent reads ownership at that moment with get_metric_raci_as_at rather than the current RACI
The answer names people, never UUIDs

cases.question: Who is in the Finance directory group in KPI Tree?
expected_behavior: The agent uses list_user_groups and get_user_group and does not confuse a directory group with a canvas group or a team
